
Qwen3.6 35B-A3B on what-if: 8-core x86 CPU (CPU only), 32 GB RAM
Scenario: Claude Code — 33k-token system prompt + tools, then ~2.5k new tokens and ~300 output tokens per turn

RUNTIME                                  FILE            CONTEXT  MEMORY        FIRST REPLY  FOLLOW-UP  WRITES AT  TASK*
Ollama (defaults)                        Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  4k ⚠     ~ 21.3/22 GB  6 min 21 s   67 s       10 tok/s   ✗ breaks
Ollama (tuned)                           Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  88k      ✗ 23.0/22 GB  —            —          —          —
llama.cpp (llama-server) (defaults)      Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  256k     ✗ 26.3/22 GB  —            —          —          —
llama.cpp (llama-server) (tuned)         Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  88k      ✗ 23.0/22 GB  —            —          —          —
LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (defaults)  Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  4k ⚠     ~ 21.5/22 GB  6 min 13 s   66 s       10 tok/s   ✗ breaks
LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (tuned)     Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  88k      ✗ 23.0/22 GB  —            —          —          —

FIRST REPLY = cold start (model load + the whole prompt). FOLLOW-UP = a typical later turn (new tokens only + the reply).
* TASK = a 40-call agent task; at datacenter speed it would take about 2 min 00 s. "✗ breaks" = the harness prompt does not fit the context.
Typical error (about 3 in 4 predictions): generation ±75%, prompt processing ±80%. CPU-only depends on memory configuration and threads; hybrid linear-attention model: little benchmark data for its recurrent layers.
Tip: CPU-only: run `trialm detect --probe` to measure memory bandwidth.

  · CPU-only: memory bandwidth assumed; run `trialm detect --probe` to measure it
  · memory bandwidth assumed (~dual-channel DDR4/DDR5); run with --probe to measure

  ⚠ Ollama (defaults): Claude Code's ~33k-token prompt does not fit the 4096-token context (Ollama default for 22 GiB of GPU memory): the prompt is silently truncated and the agent will misbehave
  ⚠ Ollama (defaults): memory is tight: other apps or a longer context may push it over
  ⚠ quality caveat: the trial uses the cloud's provider-dependent weights; local Q4_K_M is typically 0–3 points worse on coding tasks and makes more tool-call mistakes
  ⚠ Ollama (tuned): does not fit: needs 23.0 GB, 22.0 GB available
  ⚠ llama.cpp (llama-server) (defaults): does not fit: needs 26.3 GB, 22.0 GB available
  ⚠ llama.cpp (llama-server) (tuned): does not fit: needs 23.0 GB, 22.0 GB available
  ⚠ LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (defaults): Claude Code's ~33k-token prompt does not fit the 4096-token context (LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) default load setting): the middle of the conversation is silently cut
  ⚠ LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (defaults): memory is tight: other apps or a longer context may push it over
  ⚠ LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (tuned): does not fit: needs 23.0 GB, 22.0 GB available

Recommendation: no runtime gives a working Claude Code setup for this model here — try a smaller quant (--quant), a smaller model, or --ctx.
